# Cache

Build-specific cache extracts used for reverse-engineering the client cache format.

## Files

- `opcodes-build940-4249236733.json` — Opscript/cs2 opcode definitions extracted from build 940.
- `scripts-build940-249972130.json` — Script argument/type definitions extracted from build 940.

## Usage

These JSON artifacts feed opcode mapping, script signature analysis, and cache tooling for the POG2 decompilation pipeline.
